tier_reason: Tier C stands but the provenance is weaker than recorded: RawTherapee's lab2rgbOut passes cmsFLAGS_NOOPTIMIZE and lcms2 2.11 and later (2.11, 2.12 and master cmsxform.c checked) skip transform plugins under that flag, so the 5312 ms versus 754 ms comparison in issue #6016 can only have come from an unpublished patched build. The record's 'used by RawTherapee' is false: issue #6016 is still open and RawTherapee's CMakeLists.txt, iccstore.cc, init.cc and main.cc never call cmsFastFloatExtensions. The 7x path is a 51^3 tetrahedral Lab CLUT approximation (clamps L to 0..100 and a/b to plus or minus 128).

corrections.stars_or_usage: 751 stars (Little-CMS repo); shipped in lcms2 since 2.10 (ChangeLog). Not used by RawTherapee: issue #6016 remains open and its sources never call cmsFastFloatExtensions.
corrections.caveats: The only number (RawTherapee issue #6016, 5312 ms stock versus 754 ms with the plugin) needs an unpublished patched build, because RawTherapee passes cmsFLAGS_NOOPTIMIZE and lcms2 2.11+ skips transform plugins under that flag; no CPU, thread count, compiler or flags. The 7x path is a 51^3 tetrahedral Lab CLUT approximation (L clamped to 0..100, a/b to plus or minus 128); the testbed accepts float results differing from stock lcms2 by up to 0.005 (0.007 in another check). The plugin is GPL-3.0-or-later (commercial licence sold) while the lcms2 core is MIT. Autotools builds the plugin with -Ofast (isnan guards may vanish); SSE2 only, no NEON. Past wrong-output bugs, all closed: #272, #325 (about 100x off in 2.13.1), #247 (Krita); segfaults #236 and #260.
